title: Ukwanga hagati y'ubwinshi bw'ibintu
intro: Usanga uri mu bantu bafite amasoko yuzuyemo ubucuruzi, nyamara iminzani yabo iragwa mu buryo butari bwo. Intumwa yabagezeho ibaburira neza, ariko baraseka barahindukira, bizeye ko baguwe neza. Ijuru ritangiye kwijima, ariko babibona nk'umugisha w'imvura. Aba bantu ni bande?
clues: Twateye imbere mu bihugu by'ubucuruzi n'ubukire, nyamara imitima yacu yaracitse intege.
Intumwa yatugezeho izanye ibimenyetso bivuye ku Mwami wacu, ariko twamusekaga.
Twari tuzwiho ubucuruzi bwacu, ariko twatanze uburyo bworoshye kandi dushuka abantu.
Twabaga mu biti binini n'ibimera bitoshye, ariko twafashe imigisha yacu nk'aho ari ubusa.
Igihe igicu cyijimye cyageraga, twishimye, twibwira ko kizazana imvura mu butaka bwacu bwumye.
Ahubwo, icyo gicu cyatugejeje ku gihano gikaze, maze dufatwa n'ububabare bw'umunsi w'igicucu.
